model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the percentage share of economically active individuals (Anteil Erwerbstätige in %) across different age groups (Alter), categorized by migration background. The x-axis represents age in years, ranging from 20 to 70, with tick marks at regular intervals of 10 years. The y-axis represents the percentage of economically active individuals, scaled linearly from 0% to 100%, with grid lines and labeled tick marks at intervals of 20%. Four distinct lines represent different migration status groups: a solid black line for individuals without a migration background, a solid gray line for those born in Germany, a solid light blue line for those who immigrated up to 2009, and a solid dark blue line for those who immigrated since 2010. The black line starts at approximately 60% at age 20, rises to a peak near 85% around age 35, and then gradually declines to below 10% by age 70. The gray line begins at approximately 50% at age 20, peaks near 80% around age 35, and declines to approximately 10% by age 70. The light blue line starts at approximately 35% at age 20, peaks near 70% around age 35, and declines to approximately 10% by age 70. The dark blue line begins at approximately 35% at age 20, peaks near 70% around age 35, and declines to approximately 10% by age 70. All lines show a general downward trend after age 50, with the black line remaining consistently above the others until approximately age 60.
